title: SERENITY — A Story in Layers (Scent Layering concept)

authoring.reasoningSummary: Offline SERENITY-only concept inference from supplied product facts and media frames. Five explicitly synthetic social-format signals feed two synthetic indices, one product-grounded Lavish analysis, new English and Arabic 15-second scripts and hypothetical future replay/delivery. The supplied 10.08-second video is separately registered as an independent Provided Preview.
assumptions: Scent Layering remains a legacy scenario container; “layers” means a creative sequence of impressions within one SERENITY fragrance, not verified mixing with another product.
A quiet fragrance story may interest a hypothetical UAE/GCC audience; none of the synthetic data establish demand.
The three supplied files and user-provided logo may be reused for internal demo; external advertising rights require separate confirmation.
limitations: No external social platform data was collected; signal values, source examples and chart points are purely synthetic.
The official source refers to citrus, floral and musk; exact note order, bottle capacity and ingredient origin are not verified.
The user-supplied 10.08-second, 720x960, 3:4 MP4 is NOT the schema-required 15-second, 1080x1920 concept film, nor an output of this POC.
The matching 15-second MP4 and poster are absent; bytes/hash/rights remain null/pending and the known corresponding strict schema failures are expected.
Do not attach 15-second concept subtitles to the 10.08-second provided preview; no exact timing/transcript match was verified.
The events after analysis are counterfactual future replay fixtures, not proof of actual render, attachment transfer or sent email.
Arabic text requires native language and Lavish brand review; rights to music and public campaign use remain unverified.
